Now we have retro_smarts_template. We need to apply to target molecule. Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles and template_id (maybe need to use template_id as reaction_id again). Use apply_template with template_id "1914389".
<thought>Using the retrieved retrosynthetic template (ID 1914389) for the Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons reaction, I applied it to the target molecule C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO. The template generates three possible sets of precursors, each set containing the two reactants required for the HWE reaction (the phosphonate ester and the aldehyde/ketone fragment). The precursors are returned as SMILES strings in the required list‑of‑lists format.
